rationale: A unanimous, jurisdiction-only disposition strongly favors a Chief Justice Roberts majority opinion emphasizing Summers/Clapper/Lyons and rejecting Havens-style manufactured injury, while avoiding APA merits. Separate concurrences are most likely from Justices Thomas/Alito/Gorsuch to underscore separation-of-powers limits on APA review and from Justices Kavanaugh/Barrett to sharpen associational-standing and traceability/redressability analysis.
